provenance.method: offline rigid-body GraspNet->EEF calibration with end-to-end physical canary
provenance.eef_frame_note: OpenETA EEF pos = gripper0_grip_site position; EEF quat = robot0_right_hand body orientation (mixed frame). T_grasp_eef assembled against this exact convention.
provenance.approach_axis: +X column of the GraspNet rotation is the approach direction; translation origin is grasp translation_xyz (depth-independent).

candidate_status.reason: Full physical canary below threshold (reach 1/5, lift 0/5). All failures attributed by telemetry to grasp execution / scene selection (short flat objects, top-down insertion, non-pad geometry hitting the table, OSC pushed off by contact torque), none to the calibration itself.
candidate_status.not_validated_because: held-out lift < 95%; grasp controller (table-clearance guard, reject-extended-config, close->lift dynamics) not yet implemented.
candidate_status.gates_unchanged: finger-center P95 <= 5mm, axis P95 <= 3 deg, held-out lift >= 95%. Any miss keeps status=candidate.
candidate_status.intended_use: GraspNet-frame to Panda EEF calibration only. Task-family pose policies live in agent/strategies/grasp.
